doc: The four fields before rank encoding on a 48x48 tile, called as raw_channels(48) so the default seed 1 is the one used (params.defaults lists the defaults of the signature: size 1024, seed 1): heaps (three Worley lattices 8, 32 and 96 cells under an envelope), closed (cracks of a warped Voronoi with a wandering half-width, closing where open_crack drops to 0, domes, lumpy tops on a 64-cell lattice), open (a wall band times the lumps plus the faint wall and inward terms, with a clear-center plateau of 66 exact zeros) and sheet (an fBm, low 2, slope 3). ALL the random draws of the call are the inputs, plan0 to plan19 in call order (worley, fbm, poisson, lumps; the descriptors in params.plans give the size, freq, seed... of each draw). params.plan_roles names the role of each draw (plan0 to plan2 the heaps lattices, plan3 to plan11 the closed channel, plan12 to plan18 the open channel, plan19 the sheet) and params.stages gives every formula with the inline literals that params.constants (the module constants) does not hold. NOTE: plan6 and plan7 are the SAME draw (the closed crack width is drawn with the seed of the y-warp fBm, seed + 105, low 3, slope 3: width and warp are one correlated field), and so are plan15 and plan16 in the open channel (seed + 155): a port that draws independent fields is statistically different from the Python maps; share the draw to match them. The per-function cases cover every piece, this one the composition and the call order. Measured: every random input nudged by one float64 ulp (8 trials) and numpy.fft replaced by scipy.fft: max |diff| 5.6e-14 (closed), 2.2e-15 to 2.2e-14 on the others (scipy.fft: 7.3e-15), no flipped Voronoi cell and no flipped rank byte: 1e-9 relative / 1e-9 absolute. Intermediates (width, open_crack, depth, sag, tops, texture, wall...) are not frozen: each is a per-function case or a closed-form expression of them (params.stages).

stages: U(low, seed, slope = 3) = ndtr(periodic_fbm(size, low, slope, seed)); F1(freq, seed) = tileable_worley(size, freq, seed)[0]; inv(f) = max(0, 1 - f); smoothstep(a, b, x) = k^2 (3 - 2k), k = clip((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1)

HEAPS: clusters = inv(F1(8 = HEAP_CLUSTERS, seed + 11)); cells = inv(F1(32 = HEAP_CELLS, seed + 23)); puffs = inv(F1(96 = PUFFS, seed + 37)); envelope = 0.5 clusters + 0.5 cells; heaps = ENVELOPE_FLOOR envelope + puffs (HEAP_BASE + (1 - HEAP_BASE - ENVELOPE_FLOOR) envelope)

CLOSED: border = warped_voronoi(size, cell_size_field(size, CLOSED_CELL_KM, seed + 101), seed + 103)[0]; width = 0.03 + 0.22 U(3.0, seed + 105); open_crack = smoothstep(0.25, 0.65, U(4.0, seed + 107)); crack = open_crack (1 - smoothstep(0, 1, border / width)); depth = 0.55 + 0.4 U(6.0, seed + 111); sag = 1 - 0.35 open_crack (1 - smoothstep(0, 0.6, border)); tops = inv(F1(64, seed + 113)); texture = 0.3 tops + 0.7 U(12.0, seed + 109, slope = 2.0); closed = sag (0.7 + 0.3 texture) (1 - depth crack)

OPEN: border_o = warped_voronoi(size, cell_size_field(size, OPEN_CELL_KM, seed + 151), seed + 153)[0]; wall_width = 0.15 + 0.3 U(3.0, seed + 155); wall = 1 - smoothstep(0, 1, border_o / wall_width); wall = wall (0.25 + 0.75 smoothstep(0.2, 0.6, U(5.0, seed + 157))); inward = 1 - clip(border_o, 0, 1); open = wall lumps(size, seed + 159) + 0.03 wall + 0.02 inward

Evaluation order, which fixes the order of the draws: heaps; the closed lines top to bottom (cell_size_field, warped_voronoi = Poisson set then its two warp fBms, width, open_crack, depth, tops, texture); the open lines in the same way (cell_size_field, warped_voronoi, wall_width, wall gaps, lumps); the sheet.
plan_roles: plan7: closed.width (the SAME draw as closed.warp_y)
plan16: open.wall_width (the SAME draw as open.warp_y)
